title: Whipped Grass-Fed Tallow Cream — Lemongrass & Lavender
body_html:
Whipped grass-fed tallow cream for all-day use — the all-rounder of our tallow line. Pasture-raised beef tallow whipped with organic olive, jojoba, lemongrass, and lavender. Clarifying, calming, eczema-friendly. No seed oils, no synthetics.

Why grass-fed tallow

Grass-fed tallow's fatty acids (stearic, oleic, palmitic, palmitoleic) closely mirror human sebum — which is why it absorbs without the occlusive greasy feel of synthetic creams. Grass-fed adds higher CLA, more fat-soluble vitamins A/D/E/K, and a better omega balance than grain-fed.

Key ingredients

  • Grass-fed beef tallow — sebum-compatible lipid base, rich in fat-soluble vitamins
  • Organic olive oil + jojoba oil — squalene, oleic acid, sebum-mimicking absorption
  • Organic lemongrass + lavender essential oils — clarifying and soothing; balanced aromatherapy

How to use

Pea-sized scoop, warm between palms, massage into face, neck, or body. AM or PM — this blend is balanced enough for both.

Who it's for

Moms who want one cream that adapts to their day. Especially suited to sensitive, eczema-prone, or postpartum skin. For a dedicated day cream see Orange & Bergamot; for night, Peaceful Night.

Free from

No seed oils • No parabens • No sulfates • No synthetic fragrance • No PEGs • No phthalates

Full ingredients

Grass-Fed Beef Tallow, Organic Extra Virgin Olive Oil, Organic Golden Jojoba Oil, Organic Lemongrass Essential Oil, Organic Lavender Essential Oil

2 oz (56g) · Made in USA · 100% organic oils. External use only; avoid eyes; discontinue if irritation occurs.

faq_json.question: What does this cream smell like?
faq_json.answer: The Leaf & Bird Lemongrass & Lavender tallow cream has a balanced herbal-floral scent. Organic lemongrass gives it a clean, bright, slightly citrusy note; organic lavender adds a familiar soft calm. The combined scent is gentle and fades within about 20 minutes of application — it's aromatherapy while you apply, not a perfume that lingers all day.

faq_json.question: Is this cream safe for eczema-prone skin?
faq_json.answer: Yes. Leaf & Bird's whipped tallow cream contains no synthetic fragrance, no seed oils, no sulfates, and no parabens — the ingredient categories most commonly associated with eczema flares. Grass-fed tallow's lipid profile closely mirrors human sebum, making it one of the most biocompatible moisturizers available. Lavender essential oil has documented skin-calming properties. As with any new product, a small patch test is always wise before full application.

faq_json.question: How long does one jar last?
faq_json.answer: A 2 oz jar typically lasts 6–10 weeks with daily facial use, longer if you're using it mainly as a spot moisturizer. Tallow is highly concentrated — a pea-sized amount warms and spreads easily. If you're using it head-to-toe on a larger body area, expect closer to 3–4 weeks per jar.

faq_json.question: Is this safe to use during pregnancy?
faq_json.answer: The formula contains only grass-fed beef tallow, organic olive oil, organic jojoba oil, organic lemongrass essential oil, and organic lavender essential oil — no retinoids, no salicylic acid, no parabens, and no synthetic fragrance. However, please consult your healthcare provider or OB/GYN before adding any new skincare product during pregnancy or breastfeeding, as individual sensitivities vary. This is general information, not medical advice.

faq_json.question: Can I use this on my baby?
faq_json.answer: Many parents use whipped tallow cream on babies and young children, and the simple, clean ingredient list makes Leaf & Bird's formula a reasonable option. That said, we recommend performing a small patch test on your baby's inner arm first and observing for 24 hours, as even organic essential oils can occasionally cause sensitivity in very young skin. Consult your pediatrician if you have any concerns. This is not medical advice.

faq_json.question: What's the difference between grass-fed and grain-fed tallow?
faq_json.answer: Grass-fed tallow contains higher levels of conjugated linoleic acid (CLA), more fat-soluble vitamins A, D, E, and K, and a healthier omega-3 to omega-6 ratio compared to grain-fed tallow. These differences matter for skin: CLA supports barrier function, fat-soluble vitamins support cellular renewal and protection, and a better omega balance reduces the pro-inflammatory load that grain-fed fats can contribute. We use only pasture-raised, grass-fed sources.

faq_json.question: How much cream should I use per application?
faq_json.answer: Start with a pea-sized amount — about the size of a green pea — for full facial coverage. Warm it between your fingers for a few seconds and it will soften enough to spread evenly. Tallow is richly concentrated, so using more than you need won't improve results and will use up your jar faster. For dry patches on the body, a small coin-sized amount is usually enough for each area.
